answer: Make each extra identity cost more than the last. First, a new agent pays a $0.10 fee, but it doubles for every extra identity from the same wallet or device. Second, fees are burned, never refunded, so farms cannot recycle money. Third, identities sharing a funding source share one bill. Fourth, honest agents pay once. Running 10,000 clones costs over $50,000 a month; one honest agent pays ten cents. Like water carving a canyon, small costs build a wall; one dune shifts easily, but a desert of dunes is a mountain, and the nectar flows only to agents who earn it.
